subject.title: fix(matrix): tolerate SAS accept events missing method

question: Should OpenClaw accept this Matrix plugin wrapper around matrix-js-sdk's private Rust crypto to-device preprocessor once live Matrix proof is added?
rationale: The code path appears narrowly placed, but it depends on a private dependency boundary and touches E2EE device verification, so automation should not treat green CI as maintainer acceptance of that risk.

options.title: Require Live Proof Then Accept Wrapper
options.body: Ask for redacted Element/Synapse verification logs, terminal output, linked artifact, or recording from this branch, then merge if maintainers accept the private hook.

options.title: Pause For Upstream SDK Direction
options.body: Hold this PR and pursue a matrix-js-sdk or Element-level compatibility fix instead of carrying a private wrapper in the Matrix plugin.

options.title: Override Proof And Accept Risk
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override the proof gate and own the private dependency hook risk for this bug fix.

recommendation.title: Require Live Proof Then Accept Wrapper
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Element/Synapse verification logs, terminal output, linked artifact, or recording from this branch, then merge if maintainers accept the private hook.

likelyOwner.reason: The Matrix E2EE and verification history most strongly points to gumadeiras for the product/runtime boundary judgment.
